an10.39:1.1: [sāvatthi] atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.39:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante saṅgho bhinno hotī ti.
an10.39:1.4: idhānanda bhikkhu adhammaṃ dhammoti dīpenti, dhammaṃ adhammoti dīpenti, avinayaṃ vinayoti dīpenti, vinayaṃ avinayoti dīpenti, abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenā ti dīpenti āciṇṇaṃ, tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenā’ti dīpenti. appaññattaṃ tathāgatena paññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti.
an10.39:1.6: te imehi dasahi vatthūhi avakassanti, vavakassanti, āvenikammāni karonti, āveni pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti.
an10.39:1.7: ettāvatā kho ānanda saṅgho bhinno hoti ti.
an10.39:2.1: samaggaṃ pana bhante saṅghaṃ bhinditvā kiṃ so pasavatī ti?
